blocks.text: PRESS RELEASE: The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announces that 48 out of 159 passed the Naval Architects Computer-Based Licensure Examination
The following is a press release from the Professional Regulation Commission.

The Professional Regulation Commission (PRC) announces that 48 out of 159 passed the Naval Architects Computer-Based Licensure Examination given by the Board of Naval Architecture in NCR and Cebu this October 2026.
The members of the Board of Naval Architecture who gave the licensure examination are Engr. William B. Hernandez, officer-in-charge and Engr. Rizalito S. Lanoy, member.

Starting November 13, 2026, registration for the issuance of Professional Identification Card (ID) and Certificate of Registration will be done on-line. Please visit the official PRC website and follow the instructions for registration. Those who will register are required to bring the following: 1) Screenshot of system-generated Registration Form; 2) valid government-issued ID. Successful examinees should personally register and sign in the Roster of Registered Professionals.
The date and venue for the oathtaking ceremony of the new successful examinees in the said examination WILL BE ANNOUNCED LATER.
